blocks.tamil_translation: (O Prophet,) say: “Have you considered: if Allah were to make the night continuous over you until the Day of Resurrection, which god other than Allah would bring you light?” Will you not then listen (to this)? (O Prophet,) say: “Have you considered: if Allah were to make the day continuous over you until the Day of Resurrection, which god other than Allah would bring you the night in which you rest?” Will you not then see (and reflect on this)?

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَمِنْ آيتِهِ الْجَوَارِ فِي الْبَحْرِ كَاْلاَعْلَامِ ۞ إِنْ يَّشَأْ يُسْكِنِ الرِّيحَ فَيَظْلَلْنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلَي ظَهْرِهِ ؕ إِنَّ فِي ذلِكَ لآيتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ ۞ أَوْ يُوبِقْهُنَّ بِمَا كَسَبُوا وَيَعْفُ عَنْ كَثِيرٍ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: And among His signs are the ships sailing in the sea like mountains. If He wills, He stills the wind (so that it does not blow); then they remain standing (motionless) on its surface; indeed in this there are many sure signs for everyone who is very patient and grateful. Or He destroys them (by drowning) because of the (evil) they have earned (yet) He pardons most (of the sins).

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي:(وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا دَاوُدَ مِنَّا فَضْلاً ؕ يجِبَالُ أَوِّبِي مَعَهُ وَالطَّيْرَ ۚ وَأََلَنَّا لَهُ الْحَدِيدَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: And We certainly gave Dawud grace from Us; (We commanded:) “O mountains, glorify (Allah) again and again along with him”; and the birds too (We commanded likewise). And iron, for him,
